convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with 'BBands_Stop_v1' (unknown custom indicator) and #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> (external library for trade execution). The custom indicator logic must be manually reimplemented in Python.

derived_values.name: UpValue
derived_values.formula: iCustom buffer 4 at SignalBar and SignalBar-1 — upper Bollinger Band stop line

derived_values.name: DnValue
derived_values.formula: iCustom buffer 1 at SignalBar and SignalBar-1 — lower Bollinger Band stop line

other_exits: Long closed when DnValue[1] is non-zero (sell signal appears) and BuyPosClose permission is true
Short closed when UpValue[1] is non-zero (buy signal appears) and SellPosClose permission is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If MM < 0, |MM| is treated as fixed lot size; if MM > 0, it represents share of deposit per transaction

custom_logic_notes: The BBands_Stop_v1 custom indicator computes upper/lower Bollinger Band stop lines across 6 buffers. This EA reads buffer 4 (upper stop line) and buffer 1 (lower stop line). A non-zero value on the signal bar indicates the band is active/triggered. Entry requires both the previous bar's signal line to be active (UpValue[1] or DnValue[1]) AND the opposite band on the current bar to be active (DnValue[0] for long, UpValue[0] for short) — this confirms a trend establishment. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with signal-time deduplication (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) to prevent duplicate entries on the same bar. LoadHistory() is called to ensure bar data is available for IsNewBar() checks.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Must reimplement BBands_Stop_v1 logic: compute Bollinger Bands (period=20, dev=2), then offset by MoneyRisk factor to get stop lines. The indicator tracks which band price is touching and outputs 0 when inactive, non-zero stop level when active. 2) Must reimplement trade signal deduplication using signal timestamps. 3) Must reimplement deposit-fraction position sizing (MM param: negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit fraction). 4) The 6-buffer structure of BBands_Stop_v1 needs reverse-engineering: buffer 0=upper trend line, buffer 1=lower stop value, buffer 2=lower trend line, buffer 3=upper stop value (or similar), buffers 4-5 likely trend direction markers. 5) TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions must be replaced with standard market order logic with SL/TP in points.
